label: run
command: if [[ "$ZED_FILE" == *"/examples/"* ]]; then cargo nextest run --example "$ZED_STEM"; elif [[ "$ZED_FILE" == *"/tests/"* ]]; then cargo nextest run --test "$ZED_STEM"; elif [[ "$ZED_STEM" == "lib" ]]; then cargo nextest run --lib; elif [[ "$ZED_STEM" == "main" ]]; then cargo nextest run --bins; else cargo nextest run "$ZED_STEM"; fi

label: rust test (exact, nextest)
command: fn="$ZED_CUSTOM_RUST_TEST_NAME"; if [ -z "$fn" ]; then fn="test_usage"; fi; rel="$ZED_RELATIVE_FILE"; mp="${rel#*/src/}"; if [ "$mp" = "$rel" ]; then full="$fn"; else mp="${mp%.rs}"; base="${mp##*/}"; if [ "$base" = "mod" ]; then mp="${mp%/*}"; fi; if [ "$mp" = "lib" ] || [ "$mp" = "main" ]; then full="tests::$fn"; else mp="$(echo "$mp" | sed 's|/|::|g')"; case "$fn" in *::* ) full="$fn";; *) full="$mp::tests::$fn";; esac; fi; fi; crate_dir="$ZED_DIRNAME"; while [ ! -f "$crate_dir/Cargo.toml" ] && [ "$crate_dir" != "/" ]; do crate_dir="$(dirname "$crate_dir")"; done; cd "$crate_dir" && dev_features=""; grep -qE '^dev *= *\[' Cargo.toml && dev_features="--features dev"; cargo nextest run -p '$ZED_CUSTOM_RUST_PACKAGE' $dev_features --run-ignored all -- "$full" --exact && case "$fn" in *_ui_png_preview) cargo run $dev_features --example send_one -- "$crate_dir/$ZED_STEM.png";; *_ui_mp4_preview) cargo run $dev_features --example send_one -- "$crate_dir/$ZED_STEM.mp4";; esac
